title: Verified Proof Refactoring with Codex and Qwen
abstract: arXiv:2611.31762v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We refactor existing Lean 4 proofs to reduce source length and checking cost while preserving theorem statements and compatibility across Lean versions. A locally served Qwen model uses the open-source Codex CLI to inspect source, retrieve declarations, and test proof replacements. The host keeps a replacement only if it improves the objective and Lean accepts it on every required version. A deterministic CPU pass then refines the verified proofs. On the 60 problems in Lean Refactor Arena, model search achieves a local mean combined score of 82.07, and cleanup raises it to 82.18. The final proofs pass all 127 required proof--version checks. Our system placed first in the open-source LLM track of Lean Refactor Arena at VeriCodeGen.

translated_title: 使用 Codex 和 Qwen 进行经验证的证明重构
translated_abstract: 我们对现有的 Lean 4 证明进行重构，以减少源代码长度和检查成本，同时保持定理陈述不变并兼容不同版本的 Lean。本地部署的 Qwen 模型使用开源的 Codex CLI 来检查源代码、检索声明并测试证明替换方案。只有当替换方案能够改善目标指标且 Lean 在所有必需版本上都能通过验证时，宿主才会保留该替换。随后，一个确定性的 CPU 流程会对已验证的证明进行进一步精炼优化。在 Lean Refactor Arena 的 60 个问题上，模型搜索取得了 82.07 的局部平均综合得分，经过清理阶段后提升至 82.18。最终证明通过了全部 127 项必需的证明-版本检查。我们的系统在 VeriCodeGen 的 Lean Refactor Arena 开源大语言模型赛道中获得了第一名。
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合本地部署 Qwen 模型与开源 Codex CLI 的系统，在保持定理陈述和跨 Lean 版本兼容性的前提下重构现有 Lean 4 证明以缩短源代码并降低检查成本，最终在 Lean Refactor Arena 开源 LLM 赛道中夺得第一名。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a system combining a locally served Qwen model with the open-source Codex CLI to refactor existing Lean 4 proofs, reducing source length and checking cost while preserving theorem statements and cross-version compatibility, achieving first place in the open-source LLM track of Lean Refactor Arena.
